title: DEFY vs RULE
directVerdict: DEFY is the more complete performance-and-pump formula; RULE is the more cognition-heavy hyper-focus formula.
majorFormulaDifferences: Dendrobium Extract: DEFY 600 mg; RULE 300 mg.
Caffeine Anhydrous: DEFY 300 mg; RULE 350 mg.
Bitter Orange Extract: DEFY 120 mg; RULE 80 mg.
Dicaffeine Malate: DEFY 75 mg; RULE 50 mg.
Mucuna Pruriens: DEFY 50 mg; RULE 100 mg.
Only DEFY discloses: Betaine Anhydrous: 5 g per 2 scoops; Choline Bitartrate: 600 mg per 2 scoops; N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine: 500 mg per 2 scoops.
Only RULE discloses: Lion's Mane: 800 mg per 2 scoops; Uridine Monophosphate: 250 mg per 2 scoops; Theobromine: 200 mg per 2 scoops.

DEFY caffeine: DEFY officially lists 450 mg total caffeine per 2 scoops (27.19 g); 1-scoop option also shown. RULE caffeine: RULE officially lists 485 mg total caffeine per 2 scoops; 1-scoop option also shown.
experience: At full serving, DEFY puts more weight behind pump and output with 10 g L-Citrulline and 5 g betaine. RULE shifts more of the formula toward cognition with 3 g L-Tyrosine, Lion’s Mane, Uridine, Theobromine, Alpha GPC, and a broader focus stack.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers prioritizing energy and a large disclosed pump formula
chooseSecondWhen: Customers prioritizing focus and nootropic ingredients
tradeoffs: DEFY: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
RULE: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
bottomLine: Choose DEFY when pump, betaine, and all-around training performance lead the sale. Choose RULE when the buyer specifically wants the deepest focus/nootropic experience and accepts RULE’s very-high stimulant position.
